description: Daily refresh of the digests pinned in image/pins.env (Fedora's registry drops old digests within days), which is how Fedora's updates reach OrielOS builds. GitHub Actions and the Discord bot's packages are left to Dependabot.

customManagers.description: Container images in image/pins.env, pinned as name:tag@sha256:digest

packageRules.description: Refresh the digests together, in one pull request: the two akmods images must match the same kernel.
A new Fedora release changes the tags; that move is planned separately, not proposed here.
